title: What AI assistants say about Kemira
independence: Independent audit, not affiliated with Kemira
method: Three assistants (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini) answered 10 questions, each asked twice on 20 October 2026, and every claim was checked against 22 Kemira pages and reports.

headline.line: Ask ChatGPT who supplies water treatment chemicals and 40 of the 46 links it offers go to other suppliers. Six go to Kemira.
That is all the readable text on Kemira's sustainability figures page. The numbers come from an outside service, so an assistant reading the page finds almost nothing.
Only two Kemira pages begin by answering the question the page exists for. Seven begin with a date.

never_cited.page: Half-year report (hosted on a press-release service)

links.caveat: Not every answer's sources were captured: none for Gemini's first session, and only the links inside the answer text for ChatGPT and Perplexity in their second. ChatGPT's links are those inside its answer text, which may differ from the sources its interface showed.

aggregate_row.text: 9 claims about reputational and regulatory matters, raised in answers to "Is Kemira a sustainable company? What are the criticisms?". Kemira's own pages don't address them. The full records are in the repository.

figures.also: A second climate target (33% or 32.5%) and two target dates (end of 2025 or 2026) split the same way.
figures.conclusion: Whichever figure an assistant gave, it matched one Kemira source and contradicted another.
